description: Two independent clock dividers, each with a clock input, a reset and a divided output

params.text: Divides the clock at INPUT1 by eight, four or two
Divides the clock at INPUT2 by four, three or two
Resets the count of the divider fed by INPUT1
Resets the count of the divider fed by INPUT2

inputs.text: The clock to be divided and sent to OUTPUT1
The clock to be divided and sent to OUTPUT2
A gate here resets the count of the divider fed by INPUT1
A gate here resets the count of the divider fed by INPUT2

outputs.text: The clock from INPUT1 after division
The clock from INPUT2 after division
